observations: Piray & Daw (Nature Communications 2024) explicitly use variance and temporal autocorrelation/covariance to distinguish stochasticity from volatility: both raise variance, but volatility increases temporal covariance whereas observation stochasticity dilutes autocorrelation.

The official payampiray/stovol-learning source directly computes observation variance and lag-1 autocorrelation in code/design.m, supporting variance-plus-temporal-covariance as the intended source-derived signal rather than a generic same-sign residual heuristic.
SPLiT S1 Code.zip remains publicly linked by PLOS, but file-level source payload was not recovered through the available read-only route in this invocation; no probe mutation was attempted.

bounded_audit.scope: Source-derived synthetic causal audit of uncertainty-source attribution. This is not an exact reproduction of Piray-Daw, SPLiT, PAST or GROUSE and does not validate a deployable controller.

fixed_gain_special_case.interpretation: Under independent observation noise and known gain, variance plus one lag covariance exactly separates the two variance sources; variance alone cannot.

correlated_stochasticity_extension.model: e_t=z_t+n_t; z_t=a z_{t-1}+epsilon_t with stationary variance Q; n_t=rho n_{t-1}+u_t with stationary variance S
correlated_stochasticity_extension.identifiability_boundary: When rho approaches a, denominator gamma_1-a*gamma_0 approaches zero and persistent latent variation and correlated observation stochasticity become indistinguishable from second-order temporal statistics alone.
correlated_stochasticity_extension.practical_estimator: Use gamma_0...gamma_8 and nonnegative weighted least-squares over candidate rho; robust variant MAD-clips samples before autocovariance estimation.

near_rho_equals_a.summary: rho 0.7-0.85 gives unstable attribution; at rho=0.82 and T=3000 FPR≈0.48 and TPR≈0.48, near chance.

online_rolling_probe.summary: Rolling-window multi-lag attribution reduced some false activations but clean/high-noise Q-change detection remained tens to >100 raw samples in tested windows. Because this simulator's sample clock differs from predecessor event-duration simulations, direct comparison to the predecessor ~1-event delay target is not valid; nevertheless no tested online configuration justified replacing the existing matched dual-latent controller.

mechanistic_interpretation.positive: Piray-Daw's variance-plus-temporal-covariance principle has a precise source-derived form. When observation stochasticity is independent or has a timescale distinct from latent persistence, multiple autocovariance lags can sharply reduce noise-to-volatility misattribution, including under heavy-tailed and skew innovations.
mechanistic_interpretation.negative_boundary: A one-lag or independent-noise assumption collapses under correlated stochasticity. More fundamentally, if observation-noise persistence rho matches latent persistence a, second-order temporal statistics cannot identify which source generated persistence. This is an information/identifiability boundary, not merely an estimator-tuning failure.
mechanistic_interpretation.decision: Promote multi-lag covariance attribution plus explicit identifiability abstention as the next mechanism to test, but do not promote it as a controller yet. In ambiguous rho≈a regimes, shrink to a noise-safe shared/base hazard, abstain from semantic source assignment, and block dormant-memory restore unless additional evidence breaks the symmetry.

limits: Stationary classification windows are much longer than the predecessor event-level detector and use a different generative clock; their FPR/TPR are not directly comparable to previous change-delay metrics.
The multi-lag fitter assumes approximately stationary component timescales within each estimation window and knows/conditions on latent persistence a in the main audit.

Near rho=a, no second-order estimator can solve the semantic decomposition without extra information; higher-order statistics, spectral structure, semantic cues, multiple sensors, interventions or priors may be necessary.
Heavy-tail/skew tests alter innovation distributions but not all possible nonstationary correlated-burst processes.
No source-exact PAST/GROUSE or SPLiT execution occurred.
bounded_audit.exact_next_action: Continue read-only SPLiT S1 Code.zip recovery without mutation. Build a Bayesian multi-lag innovation-state learner that tracks gamma0..gammaL, jointly infers latent persistence and correlated-stochasticity persistence, and carries an explicit identifiability score based on separation of component timescales/posterior decomposition. When decomposition is ambiguous, abstain, shrink to a shared/base hazard and block dormant-memory restore. Test it in a shared event-level simulator against regime-only Bayes and the predecessor matched four-state controller under clean changes, correlated bursts, scale drift, heavy tails/skew, stochasticity changes and high-noise true changes using disjoint calibration/held-out seeds. Require stable-noise false alarms below single-latent filters without materially worsening predecessor clean-change delay or its ~5.5-event high-noise penalty. Add spectral/higher-order evidence only if it resolves the rho≈a identifiability zone. Only after passing that gate connect the posterior to a genuine O(Nk) PAST/GROUSE-style dormant-memory tracker with weak/delayed semantic cues.
